# Specialty Tree Service

> Specialty Tree Service is a licensed and insured tree care company serving Valdosta, GA and Lowndes County since 1980. Founded by Mike Boggan, we specialize in hazardous tree removal, crane-assisted removal, and emergency storm cleanup.

## Contact Information
- **Phone:** (229) 341-5953 (24/7 emergency line)
- **Location:** Valdosta, GA
- **Service Area:** Valdosta, Hahira, Lake Park, Remerton, Statenville, and all of Lowndes County
